interpretation.eigenvalue_metric: relative error against the fixed-index continuum Dirichlet eigenvalue
interpretation.eigenvector_metric: one minus absolute overlap with the normalized continuum sine sampled on the same nodes
interpretation.residual_metric: Euclidean eigenpair residual divided by the largest computed discrete eigenvalue
interpretation.expected_fixed_mode_behavior: second-order eigenvalue convergence for each fixed mode as the grid resolves it
interpretation.expected_spectral_behavior: accuracy is not uniform when mode index grows in proportion to grid dimension
interpretation.eigenvector_limitation: nodal overlap is not an error norm for an interpolated continuum wavefunction
